messages.content: Help me generate a DMG setup script for an application named 'PhotoEditor' located at '/Applications/PhotoEditor.app', with a custom background image and ensuring the script reflects the correct volume URL and installation directory when creating a macOS package using jpackage?

function.name: MacDmgBundler_prepareDMGSetupScript
function.description: Prepares a DMG setup script for a macOS application package, including the volume URL, background image file, and installation directory. Note that the provided function is in Java 8 SDK syntax.

appLocation.description: The file system path string to the application location. This is Java String type parameter in string representation.

params.description: A map of parameters that may include the application name, images root, background image folder, and other packaging parameters. This is Java HashMap type parameter in string representation.

We need to provide a map with application name, images root, background image folder, etc. The function expects a string representation of Java HashMap. We need to produce a JSON string? The function signature: params: string. It says "This is Java HashMap type parameter in string representation." So we need to pass a string that represents a Java HashMap. That could be something like "{appName=PhotoEditor, imagesRoot=/path/to/images, backgroundImageFolder=backgrounds, ...}". But we need to include volume URL and installation directory. The volume URL is typically "file:///Volumes/PhotoEditor" or something. The installation directory is "/Applications". So we need to include those.

We need to produce a DMG setup script. The function will generate it. We just need to call the function. Provide the parameters.

})

"{appName=PhotoEditor, imagesRoot=/path/to/images, backgroundImageFolder=backgrounds, volumeURL=file:///Volumes/PhotoEditor, installDir=/Applications}"

We also might need to include other packaging parameters like "backgroundImageFile=bg.png".
